title: VerificationReport
description: Normalized objective-verifier output (gate_runner.GateResult + eval-tower tier scorers + math/retrieval/constraint checkers). Each check carries a THREE-VALUED outcome pass|fail|inconclusive: verifier precedence over the reviewer applies ONLY to conclusive (pass/fail) verdicts, because formalization incompleteness yields ~15% false-positives (Sistla 2509.26546). A FAIL check MUST carry a `certificate` (failing assertion / counterexample / unsat core / diff / trace) — that is the request_evidence payload (intake-842/843). Immutable once emitted.

report_id.description: Unique identifier for this verification report.

conclusive_verdict.description: Aggregate verdict; 'inconclusive' whenever any required check is inconclusive. v1.1: 'conflict' whenever two conclusive checks disagree under identical assumptions (spec §7.2/§7.3 rule 4 — escalates automatic approval).

unknown.description: v1.1 (spec §6.3). Count of checks with logical_status=unknown (epistemic unknown, distinct from operational error).

operational_error.description: v1.1 (spec §6.3/§7.2). Count of checks with execution_status in {error,timeout,unavailable} — tool failure, NOT proof of logical failure. The reducer applies the profile's failure policy, never treats these as fail.

conflicts.description: v1.1 (spec §6.3/§7.3). Count of criteria where conclusive checks disagree — triggers escalation in the reducer.

satisfied.description: True only when every mandatory criterion has a conclusive pass with adequate authority.

unresolved.description: Mandatory criterion_ids left unknown/unavailable (not conclusively passed or failed).

failed.description: Mandatory criterion_ids with a conclusive failure.

check.description: One normalized verifier result. A FAIL requires a certificate; an INCONCLUSIVE requires an inconclusive_reason.

check_id.description: Identifier for this check (gate_name, test id, scorer id, tier id).

kind.description: Verifier family (domain-general — not only code gates).

outcome.description: Three-valued outcome. Precedence over reviewer applies only to pass/fail.

required.description: Whether this check is required for the aggregate conclusive_verdict.

instrument.description: Instrument identity + version producing this outcome (MEASUREMENT.md attestation).

inconclusive_reason.description: Why the verifier could not conclude (timeout, unsupported construct, formalization gap).

logical_status.description: v1.1 (spec §6.2/§7.2). Epistemic verdict, SEPARATE from execution_status: a solver returning UNKNOWN is logical=unknown/execution=ok; two sound verifiers disagreeing is logical=conflict. Do not collapse tool failure into epistemic uncertainty. When present, supersedes `outcome` for reducer logic (outcome kept for v1 back-compat: pass↔pass, fail↔fail, inconclusive↔unknown).

execution_status.description: v1.1 (spec §6.2/§7.2). Operational health of the verifier run. An error/timeout/unavailable is NOT proof of failure (§7.3 rule 5) — the reducer applies the profile's operational-error policy.

criterion_id.description: v1.1 (spec §5.2). The criterion this check decides — scopes its authority (keys into AssuranceProfile.criteria / verifier_registry).

severity.description: v1.1. Severity of the criterion this check covers (mirror of AssuranceProfile.criteria[criterion_id].severity), surfaced here so the reducer's `has_conclusive_failure(minimum_severity=...)` can read it directly.

authority.description: v1.1 (spec §5.2/§7.1). Criterion-scoped authority of a check. No check has global authority merely because it is 'objective' — authority applies only to the recorded class, criteria, and implication direction. Precedence rules (§7.3): a sound_refutation FAIL blocks but its pass proves nothing; a sound_acceptance PASS establishes but its fail may be incomplete; heuristic_static/llm_judgment cannot override conclusive evidence.

class.description: Authority class governing whether this check may approve and/or block.

valid_for.description: Criterion_ids this authority is scoped to. Empty/absent = the check's own criterion_id.

may_block.description: Whether a failure of this check may block (sound_refutation/proof/complete_decider: true; sound_acceptance: false; others: policy-dependent).

may_approve.description: Whether a pass of this check may approve (proof/complete_decider/sound_acceptance: true; sound_refutation: false; others: policy-dependent).

scope.description: v1.1 (spec §5.2/§6.2). What the check actually established — the coverage and assumptions bounding its authority. A reviewer may only override conclusive scoped evidence by showing assumptions or scope differ (§7.3 rule 2).

artifact_hash.description: Content address of the exact artifact this check ran against.

coverage.description: What was actually exercised (e.g. modules, cases, branches).

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions under which the verdict holds (e.g. 'db transaction semantics match test env').

certificate.description: Machine-checkable witness for a FAIL — the request_evidence payload handed back to the author.

payload.description: The witness content (string or structured object).

location.description: Where the failure occurs (path:line, answer span, etc.).
